description: The Generator quick tier as the CI jobs run it: disjoint whole-suite shards in explicit groups, one job per group. generator-quick.js checks it against the registration-only inventories of the runner (every quick suite and test in exactly one shard, no manual or unknown suite, no empty shard, every job inside its limit); both workflows plan their matrix from it.

provenance.from: MS05r6b final quick manifest: docs/difficulty-v3/evidence/MS05r6b/quick-final/final-manifest.json (the same seven whole-suite shards; reconciled 3,262 of 3,262 Generator tests, 1,683 of 1,683 Player tests)
provenance.measured: local process seconds of one run on Windows x64, Node v26.13.0, 16 cores, time factor 2 (docs/difficulty-v3/recovery-quick-cost.md); a measurement of a named source and machine, not a promise and not a measurement of CI
provenance.counts: tests and measuredSeconds are information, not checked; the grouping, the suites and the projections are

job.rule: projected job seconds = jobOverheadSeconds + ciSlowdownFactor x the sum of the projectionSeconds of its shards; it has to fit timeoutMinutes. The factor is a stated margin (the time factor the harness uses on CI), the overhead covers checkout, setup-node, registration and the check. Neither is raised to make a group fit: split the group instead.

player.rule: one job, no option: the complete Player quick set, including every suite of core/tests/suites in the Player environment

outOfCi.note: Not run by any workflow. The suites of generator/tests/manual are listed so that a new one is a decision, and the tools are listed so that they are not mistaken for suites. What replaces them is in the workflows and in docs/difficulty-v3/evidence/MS05r6c/evidence.md.
